full_judgment: 3. The original pre-emptor Makhan Lal alleged inter alia that the land of khatian 181 belonged to 4 brothers Makhan, Mukunda, Janaki and Bhuban. Janaki sold '55 decimals of plot 71 to Sashi Charan Roy who left 3 sons as heirs. Opposite party 31, 35, 36 and 37 are the heirs of these sons. In Certificate Case No. 1511 of 1962-63 the land purchased by Sashi Charan was sold in auction on 4.1.1964, which was purchased by opposite parties 1-4 for Tk. 35/- only. The original pre-emptor Makhanlal learnt about the sale on 29.5.64 when the auction purchasers went to take delivery of possession. The original pre-emptor Makhanlal filed the pre-emption case on 31.7.64 claiming to be a co-sharer tenant and also as a contiguous land holder.
